note: The Dangerous Dogs Act 1991 bans the Pit Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, Dogo Argentino, Fila Brasileiro and XL Bully types. None is in our breed list, but the law goes by appearance, not pedigree, so a dog of another breed can still be judged to be a banned type.

Restricted breeds must be muzzled and on a short lead in public, handled by someone over 16. The list also covers the Japanese Akita, English Bull Terrier, Japanese Tosa, American Pit Bull Terrier, Bandog and crosses. XL Bully types are banned from 2025.

Pit Bull Terriers, American Staffordshire Terriers, Staffordshire Bull Terriers, Bull Terriers and their crosses may not be brought into Germany. Keeping dogs is regulated by each federal state, and several states list further breeds.

Category 1 (non-pedigree Staffordshire/American Staffordshire, Mastiff and Tosa types) cannot be bought, sold or given away. Category 2 (pedigree American Staffordshire Terrier, Rottweiler and Tosa, and Rottweiler types) needs a permit, a muzzle and a lead in public.

Owning and breeding 13 breeds and their crosses is banned, including the Pit Bull Terrier, Tosa Inu, American Staffordshire Terrier, Fila Brasileiro, Dogo Argentino, American Bulldog, Boerboel, Kangal, three ovtcharkas, Tornjak and Sarplaninac.
